/kdo-jsme/.title: About us
/kdo-jsme/.description: The Czech Maltese Youth: a youth group of people with disabilities, members of the Grand Priory of Bohemia and volunteers.
/kdo-jsme/.body:
We are a youth group that brings together people with physical or mental disabilities, members of the Grand Priory of Bohemia and volunteers from all over the Czech Republic. As an organisation that belongs to the Sovereign Order of Malta, we follow the principles of the Catholic faith in our work, in the spirit of the Order; our activities are nevertheless open to everyone who wants to help us create better conditions for the people we serve. In keeping with the tradition of the Order of Malta, our help is likewise offered to all without distinction.

Our main aim is to organise leisure and other charitable activities for young people with disabilities, for others in need and for the volunteers who help them.

Our key activities include regular trips, excursions, and spiritual, sporting and cultural events, and making it possible for young people with disabilities to take part in the international summer camp “Malta Camp”.

An integral part of our work is the training of volunteers, as well as organising events to raise funds in support of our activities.

/nase-aktivity/.title: Our activities
/nase-aktivity/.description: What the Czech Maltese Youth does: trips, rafting weekends, Malta Camp, charity punch sale, concerts and volunteer training.
/nase-aktivity/.body:
• Regular trips for young people with disabilities
  • “Společně na vodu” (Together on the water)
  • Malta Camp
  • Charity sale of Maltese punch
  • Regular charity concerts and other cultural events
  • Volunteer training, spiritual gatherings of volunteers, workshops
  • Other projects

/mam-zajem-o-sluzby/.title: I am interested in your services
/mam-zajem-o-sluzby/.description: For young people with disabilities aged 15 to 40 who would like to join the trips and events of the Czech Maltese Youth as guests.
/mam-zajem-o-sluzby/.body:
Are you between 15 and 40, and would you like to go on trips and other adventures, have the chance to travel abroad, and above all meet new friends and have a lot of fun? If you answered “YES” at least once, you are in the right place.

We are a group of volunteers who enjoy doing all these things together, and it makes us happy to share every good experience with our friends, some of whom have disabilities of various kinds.

We are not afraid of a challenge: with wheelchairs we have, for example, already rafted down several rivers, climbed a lookout tower on a rock, visited several European countries and seen countless Bohemian and Moravian towns. We have a great deal of experience and can also look after people with complex or multiple disabilities. All our friends with disabilities are our guests, and that is how we treat them: with kindness, and with the wish that they feel as much at home among us as possible.

Because we are an organisation of the Grand Priory of Bohemia of the Sovereign Order of Malta, we follow the principles of the Catholic faith in our work, and some of our activities are spiritual. Our guests do not have to be Catholics or believers of any kind. We do ask every guest to respect these principles.

If you too would like to take part in our activities, all you need to do is fill in the consent to the processing of personal data (in Czech) and state that you are a “guest” (host). You will then receive invitations to all our events. After that you only need to sign up and look forward to becoming part of a great group.

If you have any questions, or would like to know what is coming up and when, you can write to us at mladez@maltezskamladez.cz. Telephone numbers are on the contact page.

The minimum age of a participant is 15; a person under 18 must be accompanied by another person over 18 (for example a parent, guardian or sibling).

We look forward to meeting you!

/chci-byt-dobrovolnikem/.title: I want to volunteer
/chci-byt-dobrovolnikem/.description: How to become a volunteer of the Czech Maltese Youth: who we are looking for, training and how to apply.
/chci-byt-dobrovolnikem/.body:
Do you like what we do, are you at least 18, and would you like to spend part of your time helping people with disabilities and others in need? Then you are in the right place!

Our work is varied and there is something for everyone. Some prefer to look after our friends with disabilities; others cook and sell the charity punch, or help with the marketing or administration of our association. There are many ways to get involved. One is enough for some people, while others manage them all. How much you take on always depends on what you can do.

Because we are an organisation of the Grand Priory of Bohemia of the Sovereign Order of Malta, we follow the principles of the Catholic faith in our work, and some of our activities are spiritual. Our volunteers do not have to be Catholics or believers of any kind. We do ask every volunteer to respect these principles.

If you do not have enough experience of the work we do, there is no need to worry. You will receive training in how to give first aid and how to look after people with disabilities properly. We also regularly organise other educational events for our volunteers, so that each of them can, besides helping others, work on their own personal development and improve their skills.

If you would like to become one of our volunteers, fill in the consent to the processing of personal data (in Czech) and send a few words about yourself to mladez@maltezskamladez.cz (your name, your age, where you live, your profession or what you study, and whether you already have any experience of the work we do). We would also welcome a short note on why our association caught your interest. A short interview follows, and then you can be one of us!

We look forward to meeting you!

/jak-nas-podporit/.title: How to support us
/jak-nas-podporit/.description: How to support the Czech Maltese Youth with a financial or material gift.
/jak-nas-podporit/.body:
We are very grateful for all help: it is what allows us to keep going, to think up and organise more activities for the people we serve, and to grow.

Financial gift

Besides contributing at our regular benefit events, you can also help us with a financial gift to our account number 7605192/0800 (IBAN: CZ50 0800 0000 0000 0760 5192, BIC: GIBACZPXXXX).

Please give the universal variable symbol 999 111 and put your e-mail address in the note, so that we can thank you properly.

If you need a confirmation of your gift or would like to sign a gift agreement, please contact us before sending the gift. We will assign you an individual variable symbol.

Material gift

Would you like to contribute something specific? We are glad of material gifts too, and they are a great help to us. Contact us and we will arrange everything.

mladez@maltezskamladez.cz

We thank you from the heart for any contribution!

/granty-ceske-maltezske-mladeze/.title: Grants
/granty-ceske-maltezske-mladeze/.description: Grants of the Czech Maltese Youth: financial help for people with disabilities and their families.
/granty-ceske-maltezske-mladeze/.body:
The grants are financial help for people with disabilities and their families of up to CZK 30,000 a year for one person (family), which the Czech Maltese Youth provides in accordance with the rules for awarding grants.

A grant can be requested, for example, to help pay for taking part in the leisure activities organised by the Czech Maltese Youth, to buy a compensatory aid, to pay for treatment and so on.

A grant is requested through an online form, to which the relevant documents must be attached.

A five-member committee of the Czech Maltese Youth decides whether a grant is awarded.

In awarding grants we follow our principles for the processing of personal data.

/ochrana-osobnich-udaju/.title: Privacy
/ochrana-osobnich-udaju/.description: How the website of the Czech Maltese Youth handles personal data: no cookies and no tracking of visitors.
/ochrana-osobnich-udaju/.body:
Controller

The controller of personal data is Česká maltézská mládež, z.s. (Czech Maltese Youth), reg. no. (IČO) 06519555, Velkopřevorské náměstí 485/4, Malá Strana, 118 00 Prague 1, Czech Republic. Please send questions and requests about personal data to mladez@maltezskamladez.cz or to this address.

Principles and consent

In our work we follow these principles of privacy and personal data processing.

If you would like to receive information about our activities, please fill in the consent to the processing of personal data (in Czech).

Both links lead to the website of the Grand Priory of Bohemia of the Order of Malta, which runs the forms.

Cookies and analytics

This website uses no cookies and no analytics or advertising tools, and does not track visitors. Fonts and images are loaded from this website itself.

Hosting

The website runs on the servers of Vercel Inc. (USA). On every visit they process the data needed to deliver the page and to protect the website from abuse (IP address, time and address of the request, browser details). The legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating the website securely (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). These records are kept only briefly unless they are needed to resolve a security incident. Transfers to the USA rely on the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework. See Vercel's privacy notice.

Photographs from events

The news posts include photographs from our events. If you do not want a photograph showing you or your child to stay on the website, write to us at mladez@maltezskamladez.cz and we will remove it.

Email and telephone

If you write to us or call us, we use your details only to deal with your message and keep them for as long as that requires. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.

Links to other websites

Links to Facebook and other websites are plain links: nothing is passed to those services until you click them. Their own privacy policies then apply.

Your rights

You have the right of access to your personal data, to rectification or erasure, to restriction of processing and to data portability, and the right to object to processing based on legitimate interest. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Czech data protection authority, Úřad pro ochranu osobních údajů, Pplk. Sochora 27, 170 00 Prague 7, uoou.gov.cz.

Last updated: 15 November 2026. The Czech version of this notice is the authoritative one.

/pravidla-pro-udelovani-grantu/.title: Rules for awarding grants
/pravidla-pro-udelovani-grantu/.description: The rules under which the Czech Maltese Youth awards grants: who can apply, how to apply and how the committee decides.
/pravidla-pro-udelovani-grantu/.body:
Translation for information; only the Czech version is binding.

Česká maltézská mládež, z.s. (Czech Maltese Youth), Company ID (IČO): 06519555, with its registered office at Velkopřevorské náměstí 485/4, Malá Strana, 118 00 Prague 1, entered in the register of associations kept by the Municipal Court in Prague under file no. L 69268,

hereby issues the following

rules for awarding grants

(the “Rules”)

1. Introductory provisions

  1. In accordance with these Rules, the Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to award financial grants (the “Grants”), in particular to support its own activities and related activities, and also for other support of people with any kind of disability, their families and relatives, socially excluded people, people who are poor or economically disadvantaged in some other way, and other people suffering material, spiritual or other want, and their families (the “Recipients”).
  2. The Czech Maltese Youth will provide a Grant to Recipients on the basis of a gift agreement, the draft of which will be prepared by the Czech Maltese Youth.
  3. The purpose of a Grant is to help Recipients and their families and to ease their way in a difficult personal, social, health or economic situation. The aim of a Grant is to stabilise, support or otherwise meet the needs of Recipients and their families, to motivate them to make their own efforts, and to help those in need in the spirit of the values of the Czech Maltese Youth.

2. Amount of a Grant

  1. Each year the board of the Czech Maltese Youth sets the amount that may be distributed as Grants in a given calendar year. On the basis of a decision of the board of the Czech Maltese Youth, this amount may be increased during the calendar year by up to 50% (fifty per cent) of its original level.
  2. An individual Grant may range from CZK 500 to CZK 30,000.

3. Application for a Grant

  1. Only natural persons who meet the definition of Recipients under paragraph 1.1 of these Conditions are entitled to apply for a Grant.
  2. Applications for a Grant are made exclusively through the website of the Czech Maltese Youth (cmm.orderofmalta.cz).
  3. A person applying for a Grant shall state in particular their first name, surname, address, telephone, e-mail, the reasons why they should be given a Grant, and the purpose for which the Grant is to be provided (for example paying for treatment, buying a compensatory aid and so on).
  4. The Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to request any further information from a person applying for a Grant, entirely at its own discretion, including personal data and special categories of personal data (for example medical reports and so on). The Czech Maltese Youth is also entitled to consult the application for a Grant and the documents provided with other persons at its own discretion (for example with doctors, experts on the technical condition of compensatory aids and so on). The Czech Maltese Youth is further entitled to ask the applicant for a Grant for the contact details of their attending doctor and so on.
  5. An application for a Grant will usually be processed within 30 days; however, the Czech Maltese Youth may extend this period at will. An application for a Grant is considered duly submitted only once all the requested information has been provided.
  6. For a person who is unable to do so for any reason, their representative or guardian may apply for a Grant. The representative or guardian must prove their representation or guardianship to the Czech Maltese Youth.
  7. The Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to ask the applicant to complete the application or to provide evidence for the statements made in it.

4. Decision on a Grant application

  1. There is no entitlement to the award of a Grant.
  2. Grant applications are decided by a five-member (5) committee, appointed by the board of the Czech Maltese Youth for each calendar year (the “Committee”).
  3. A member of the Committee may also be a member of another body of the Czech Maltese Youth. A member of the Committee does not have to be a member of the Czech Maltese Youth.
  4. The Committee may grant an application for a Grant, grant it in part, or refuse it. The Committee may also ask the applicant to provide evidence for the statements or facts given in the application and decide on the application only afterwards.
  5. Meetings of the Committee are confidential. Minutes will be taken of each meeting of the Committee, accessible only to the members of the Committee and the members of the board of the Czech Maltese Youth.
  6. For an application for a Grant to be granted in full or in part, at least four (4) members of the Committee must vote in favour.
  7. The Committee does not have to give reasons for its decision; however, the minutes will always record how each member of the Committee voted.
  8. The applicant for a Grant will usually be informed of the Committee’s decision by e-mail, or else by telephone or letter.
  9. If the Committee grants an application for a Grant in full or in part, the applicant will be invited to conclude a gift agreement. If the applicant does not conclude the gift agreement with the Czech Maltese Youth within thirty (30) days of being notified of the Committee’s decision, their right to conclude the gift agreement lapses.
  10. The Czech Maltese Youth is entitled, at any time until the Grant is paid to the Recipient, to withdraw from paying the Grant without giving reasons.

5. Use of a Grant

  1. A Grant will be provided to Recipients in a manner the Committee considers suitable, for example as a discount on an event organised by the Czech Maltese Youth, by bank transfer to the applicant for the Grant, to a third party and so on.
  2. Recipients must use a Grant for the purpose for which the Czech Maltese Youth provided it.
  3. The Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to request proof of how a Grant has been used (for example proof of purchase of a compensatory aid, an invoice for a recuperative stay and so on). If the proof is not provided when the Czech Maltese Youth asks for it, the Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to withdraw from the gift agreement providing the Grant and to demand the return of the gift (the Grant).
  4. Any person is entitled to receive more than one Grant in a calendar year. However, the total amount paid to one person in one calendar year will never exceed CZK 30,000.
  5. Every Recipient expressly agrees that the award of a Grant may be used for PR purposes and to promote the Czech Maltese Youth. For this purpose the Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to ask the Recipient for, for example, a photograph and so on. If the Recipient does not provide the necessary cooperation in this respect, the Czech Maltese Youth is entitled to withdraw from the agreement providing the Grant.

6. Final provisions

  1. These Conditions may be amended at any time by a decision of the board of the Czech Maltese Youth.
  2. These Conditions are binding on applicants for a Grant, Recipients and any other persons to whom these Conditions apply.
  3. These Conditions are valid from 30 November 2019.
